Hi Sarah — thanks for sending these over and for the clear asks. Wed 10:30am PT works for me; I've tentatively proposed it on the calendar (invite will follow).

To make the sync productive, here's a short pre-call checklist so we don't spin on clarifying questions:

- SAML: please confirm your IdP Entity ID, Assertion Consumer Service (ACS) endpoint expectation, and whether you will sign assertions or only the response. We expect the IdP to send group claims (group membership) as either an array or a delimiter-separated string.
- SCIM: confirm whether you will be doing full push provisioning or just group sync. Provide a sample user JSON if possible.
- Service account: what cloud provider / permissions model will you use for the SCIM service account? (GCP service account, Azure SPN, etc).
- Terraform: we have a small reference module that creates the control-plane service account and minimal role bindings — I'll attach the internal checklist and a recommended role mapping doc prior to the call.

CCing Kimberly, Markus, and Marcus from our infra/identity team to pick up the detailed mapping.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Acme Health — role/SCIM checklist (prep for Wed sync)

Team — prepping notes for tomorrow's sync with Acme Health. Key items we should confirm and commit to: 

1) Minimal role set (we propose):
   - redwood-priv-deploy-observer (read-only audit & metrics)
   - redwood-priv-admin (service account: create/delete configs, rollouts)
   - redwood-scim-provisioner (SCIM user/group write, limited to /Users /Groups endpoints)

2) SCIM provisioning details:
   - Support standard RFC7644 attributes: userName, name, emails, externalId, groups.
   - Group -> Redwood role mapping: use attribute 'groups' values mapped to role names in our connector config (CSV or JSON).
   - Provisioning cadence: near-real-time (webhook-driven preferred) or 15m poll fallback.

3) SAML expectations:
   - SP entity ID: https://private.redwood.com/sp/acme-health
   - ACS endpoint: https://private.redwood.com/saml/acs/acme-health
   - Required attributes: email (urn:oid:0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.3), groups (custom claim).

4) Terraform / IaC:
   - Provide a small module we can recommend: creates SCIM service account, attaches redwood-scim-provisioner role, outputs service account key / workload identity config.
   - We will add acceptance test step that verifies SCIM push can create a dummy user via a staging endpoint.

5) Audit & KMS: need to confirm whether Acme will require customer-managed keys for secrets. If yes, add to action items.

I'll attach our internal role-sync reference and a SCIM mapping template (redwood-terraform-role-sync.md / redwood-scim-mapping.xlsx) so we can share a single doc in the call.

Props: Markus — can you prepare a short list of the exact permission bits for the redwood-priv-admin role? Marcus — can you confirm whether our staging endpoint can accept a signed SAML assertion for test.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Identity & Platform PM | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-terraform-role-sync.md (text/markdown)]

Subject: Re: Private CP onboarding — IAM/SCIM role sync

Alex / team — thanks. Quick answers ahead of the call: 

- We're using GCP for the private deployment. Our IdP will be Google Workspace SAML.
- We'll attach our SAML metadata file to this reply. Signing: assertions will be signed.
- SCIM: we plan to enable group push only (no full user push initially). We'll provide a sample groups payload.
- Service account: we'll create a GCP service account; we were planning to use roles/iam.serviceAccountUser and roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser for workload identity. Is that sufficient for your SCIM connector?
- KMS: Acme requires CMEK for any long-lived secrets in prod. We'll need your guidance on integrating KMS for secrets used by the SCIM connector.

Attaching acme-saml-metadata.xml (again) and a small example groups.json. Looking forward to tomorrow.

Thanks,
Sarah Mills
Head of IT Security, Acme Health
